title: In my view
subtitle: 「依我看／在我看來／就我而言」，究竟是哪一種 in my view？
description: 「依我看／在我看來／就我而言」，究竟是哪一種 in my view？

falseSynonyms.zh: 事實上不等於個人意見 in fact 用來陳述、澄清或強調事實；in my view 明確標示個人判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON In fact presents something as factual; in my view presents a personal opinion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 看來似乎不等於依我看 apparently 表示根據表面證據或聽聞看來如此；不一定是說話者自己的立場。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Apparently reports an appearance or report; in my view states the speaker's own judgment.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通常不自然 英語一般不會用 according to me 來表示『依我看』；應說 in my opinion / in my view / as I see it。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON According to me is generally unnatural for expressing a personal opinion in standard English.

falseSynonyms.zh: 我知道不等於我認為 I know 表示說話者把某事當作已知事實；in my view 則保留主觀判斷性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I know claims knowledge; in my view signals opinion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 肯定地不等於依我看 definitely 表示高度確定；它不標示這只是個人觀點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Definitely expresses certainty, not viewpoint.

falseSynonyms.zh: 大概不等於依我看 probably 表示機率較高；in my view 表示立場或判斷角度。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Probably expresses likelihood; in my view expresses opinion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通常不是標準『依我看』 from my side 多用於表示自己這一方的行動或責任，不自然用作一般 opinion marker。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON From my side usually refers to one's side or responsibility, not a general personal opinion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞片語與固定表達不同 my view 是名詞片語；in my view 是固定介詞片語，用來引出個人意見。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON My view is a noun phrase. In my view is a discourse marker for opinion.
